results.question: What were the top 5 products by total sales?
results.sql:
SELECT p.ProductName, SUM(od.Quantity * od.UnitPrice * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalSales
FROM [Order Details] od
JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID
GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.ProductName
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
LIMIT 5;

results.question: Which customers have the highest order frequency?
results.sql:
SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, COUNT(o.OrderID) AS OrderFrequency
FROM Customers c
JOIN Orders o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName
ORDER BY OrderFrequency DESC LIMIT 1;
